resources.string: ADD: each playback tap appends another example; online and offline queue separately. Stop cancels all app sessions in that engine. Leaving the page cancels both engines and removes listeners. ASR is unaffected.

FLUSH: each playback tap replaces existing TTS on the same engine and may interrupt other apps. Stop cancels all app sessions in that engine. Leaving the page cancels both engines and removes listeners. ASR is unaffected.
%1$s: the Manager returned no valid session ID. Submission may have failed or fallen back to a legacy API, which cannot guarantee session queries or cancellation. Use matching system firmware.
TTS operation failed (%1$s). Check SDK connection and service authorization.
Online TTS: the direct glasses route has no network. Connect Wi-Fi and try again.
%1$s: cancellation requested for all app sessions in this engine. Final state is reported by callbacks.
